name: P-015 R-3 live-plane observation on the STAGING operator (2026-09-23b): ideate on/off stack transition served by :3170 d57def4280, desired->prepared->applied receipts, actor/principal stability, per-layer span join

sudo -n -u postgres psql -d papercusp -f .papercusp/scratch/r7/r3-drill2/q-activation.sql | q-spans.sql | q-serving.sql | q-usage.sql   # read-only; SQL in replication[]

timeBasis: startedAt is the :3170 /api/health read that opened the drill (12:07:15.404Z, sha d57def4280); the drill finished 12:07:23.472Z (timeline.txt). The reads used database clock_timestamp(): spans 12:13:27Z, serving shas 12:13:54Z, activation events + control_state 12:16:01Z (finishedAt).
summary: The 2026-09-23 01:17Z observation could not show a transition served by the STAGING operator, because this session's MCP path is :9071 -> :3070 and :3070 (80521d598f) serves older identity-grants-port.ts and control-anchor.ts blobs. This drill ran the transition through :3170 at d57def4280, whose four R-3 source blobs equal the canonical tree's. Enabling ideate produced generation 64 (desired 16871, prepared 16872, applied 16873), and disabling it produced generation 65 (16876 / 16877 / 16878). Every event carries actor == owner, principal system:superuser and adv session 29827. The applied events opened layer spans: gen 64 has the ideation slot, and gen 65 closes it at exactly the gen-65 applied time. The five drill tool calls were all recorded with serving_host port-3170 and serving_build_sha d57def4280.

subject.note: The observer's own psu session. The transient ideate overlay was enabled and disabled within 8 seconds purely as a stack transition to observe; the session's AUTO mode and fleet-member posture were unchanged throughout.

replication.note: re-running it performs a new transient ideate on/off transition for the invoking owner; take new baselines first (max session_identity_activation_events.id, span count, max tool_invocations.id)

assertions.evidence: Served by :3170 d57def4280. mode:set ideate=on (12:07:15.4-16.1Z) wrote 16871 desired gen 64 (spec d1a7f0664d90, state 61d8bb41ea8d, stack auto+fleet-member+ideate, 12:07:15.748Z). The turn-start boundary (12:07:16.1-17.8Z) then wrote 16872 prepared (16.216Z) and 16873 applied (16.283Z) with the same revision pair. mode:set ideate=off wrote 16876 desired gen 65 (state 16ca1bfd8aee, stack auto+fleet-member, 19.965Z); the next boundary wrote 16877 prepared (20.916Z) and 16878 applied (20.962Z). Each applied row follows its own prepared row for the same pair, no row carries a failure, and the final control_state status is applied.

All six events carry actor_id == owner_id (su-38e71009...), principal_id system:superuser and adv_session_id 29827. The five spans opened by 16873/16878 carry the same actor and principal. The transition did not re-attribute the session.

session_identity_layer_spans for the owner: activation 16873 (gen 64) opened three spans (autonomy:su.mode-auto, fleet-posture:su.fleet-member, ideation:su.mode-ideate), active 12:07:16.283Z-12:07:20.962Z. Activation 16878 (gen 65) opened two (autonomy, fleet-posture) from 12:07:20.962Z, with no ideation span. So each layer's span boundary equals the applied time of the generation that attached or detached it. Drill calls 12 and 13 (state:read, work_items:get at 12:07:18.2-18.7Z) fall inside the gen-64 ideation span; call 16 (state:read at 12:07:23.1Z) falls inside gen 65 with no ideation span.

tool_invocations for the owner in 12:07:15-12:07:24Z: all five drill calls (mode:set x2, state:read x2, work_items:get) carry serving_host port-3170 and serving_build_sha d57def4280. The only :3070 rows in the window are hook-side activity:report (15.475Z) and coord:glance (17.863Z, 19.786Z). The gen-64 prepared/applied rows (16.216/16.283Z) precede the first glance, and the 19.786Z glance precedes gen-65 desired (19.965Z), so neither :3070 call can have acknowledged either generation.

The :3170 turn-start-memory responses carried both payloads: 11 (after ideate on) a ⟦stack⟧ attach op for slot ideation / su.mode-ideate plus a ⟦CTRL:transition⟧ block with modes [auto, ideate]; 15 (after ideate off) a ⟦stack⟧ detach op for the same slot plus a CTRL block with modes [auto].
